benefits.name: Inflight Wi-Fi credit
benefits.notes: Up to $25 back on inflight Wi-Fi purchases on American Airlines-operated flights each account anniversary year. Card is being converted to the Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select from April 24, 2026; this is the last known Barclays benefit set.

benefits.name: Companion certificate
benefits.notes: $99 (plus taxes/fees) domestic economy companion certificate after spending $20,000 in the account anniversary year; account must stay open 45 days past the anniversary.
